method: Ten original pieces, one per mythology, authored as mode, form, chords, melodies and section layers (Tools/TowerMusic/myth_pieces.py) and rendered offline by Tools/TowerMusic/render_myth.py with recorded CC0 guitar, bass, drum and brass samples plus synthesized winds, bowed strings, zithers, harp, keyboards, drones and percussion. Not a live performance.

external_samples.name: Karoryfer Shinyguitar electric pickup
external_samples.author: Karoryfer Samples / D. Smolken
external_samples.recording: Real recorded electric guitar magnetic pickup
external_samples.mapping_note: root_midi follows original SFZ pitch_keycenter (default 60 where omitted).
external_samples.tuning_note: tuning_cents is measured recorded pitch offset above root_midi (positive means sharp), estimated from weighted first four harmonics 0.2-1.4 seconds after onset. To play target MIDI use rate=2**((target-root_midi-tuning_cents/100)/12). Source WAV bytes preserved unmodified.
external_samples.onset_note: onset_frame marks first sample over max(0.002, peak*0.01), retaining 1.5 ms pre-attack; optional start point for tight note placement.

external_samples.author: Karoryfer Samples / D. Smolken

external_samples.tuning_note: tuning_cents is measured recorded pitch offset above root_midi (positive means sharp), estimated from weighted first four harmonics 0.2-1.4 seconds after onset. To play target MIDI use rate=2**((target-root_midi-tuning_cents/100)/12). Source WAV bytes preserved unmodified.

external_samples.author: Karoryfer Samples / Karoryfer Lecolds
external_samples.mix_notes: Original close microphone + stereo overhead, plus quiet bottom snare microphone. Common onset trim and 15ms tail fade. Constant gain per articulation; no synthesized drums, no pitch changes, no normalization per hit.
external_samples.velocity_notes: velocity is the rounded upper bound of the original evenly spaced source layer (127 * layer / layer_count). Choose nearest desired velocity, then rotate round_robin. Recorded level differences are preserved; do not normalize each hit.

external_samples.library: VSCO 2 Community Edition (VS Chamber Orchestra: CE)
external_samples.author: Versilian Studios / Sam Gossner & Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler (Soundemote)
external_samples.selection: Trumpet, F horn and tenor trombone: sus and stac articulations, every velocity layer and round robin.
external_samples.processing: Common leading silence trimmed (2 ms kept), sustains shortened to 4.5 s with an 80 ms fade, staccatos given a 15 ms tail fade, one fixed gain per instrument/articulation, stereo and sample rate kept, FLAC output.
external_samples.pitch_convention: VSCO names middle C as C3; root_midi follows that (C3 = 60). tuning_cents is the measured autocorrelation pitch offset from the named note.

external_samples.library: VSCO 2 Community Edition (VS Chamber Orchestra: CE)
external_samples.author: Versilian Studios / Sam Gossner & Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler (Soundemote)
external_samples.processing: Leading silence trimmed (2 ms kept), long sustains shortened with an 80 ms fade, short samples given a 15 ms tail fade, stereo and sample rate kept, FLAC output. No instrument waveform is synthesized.
external_samples.pitch_convention: VSCO usually names middle C as C3 (C3 = 60); the upright piano, harp, solo violin Arco Vib and tubular bells folders name it C4 instead, so their root_midi values are lowered by 12 (verified by autocorrelation pitch measurement). Timpani roots are measured per drum. tuning_cents is the measured offset from the root where the measurement was reliable.

reference: Mood references only (Undertale 'Once Upon a Time', Mega Man X6 'Moonlight'); no audio, samples or melodies from any existing work are used.
audio_format: 44.1 kHz stereo; PCM16 WAV masters and Vorbis OGG runtime assets.
qa_scope: Automated decoded-audio measurements and separate Unity playback smoke. No claim of human auditory review.
